results.title: Scaleway announces new GPU Zone in Copenhagen powered by NVIDIA B300 | Scaleway
results.author: Made with ❤️ by FWEB, VDESIGN, VI
highlights:
Paris, October 13, 2026 – At ai-PULSE 2026, Scaleway, the European cloud and AI provider, today announces plans to open a new GPU Zone in Copenhagen, Denmark, powered by NVIDIA HGX B300.

As demand for AI computing continues to accelerate, European organizations are increasingly looking for access to advanced GPU technologies while maintaining control over where their workloads are hosted and operated. The new Copenhagen GPU Zone will respond to these needs, extending Scaleway's GPU offering to Denmark and bringing computing capacity closer to customers across Northern Europe.

...

Scaleway is introducing GPU Zones, dedicated locations designed to provide large-scale GPU capacity for AI training and inference, complementing its existing cloud Availability Zones.

results.title: Scaleway scales up to power Europe's AI ambitions | Scaleway
results.author: Made with ❤️ by FWEB, VDESIGN, VI
highlights:
Paris, October 13h - At ai-PULSE 2026, Scaleway announces new infrastructure deployments across Europe, expands its computing capacity and strengthens its technology partnerships to enable businesses to develop and deploy their artificial intelligence applications from Europe.

...

#### Expanding cloud and GPU infrastructure across Europe

Scaleway's European expansion will continue in 2027 with the opening of three Availability Zones in Stockholm, Sweden, and three additional zones in Frankfurt, Germany, further extending the geographic reach of its cloud platform.

Alongside this expansion, Scaleway is investing in additional computing capacity through the development of GPU Zones, dedicated infrastructure designed to support large-scale AI model training and inference.

Two major deployments are announced:

- In Stockholm, a new AMD Instinct™ MI355X GPU cluster, with the ambition of delivering one of the first computing infrastructures of its kind from a European cloud provider.
- In Copenhagen, a new NVIDIA B300 cluster, featuring several thousand GPUs to meet the growing computing requirements of AI applications.

With GPU Zones in Paris, Copenhagen and Stockholm, Scaleway is building an infrastructure that will eventually represent tens of thousands of GPUs, tens of exaflops of computing power and tens of megawatts of capacity.

By offering a broader range of processor architectures, Scaleway aims to give businesses access to leading technologies while preserving their freedom to choose the infrastructure best suited to their needs.

...

- Milan: a fully fledged cloud region with 3 AZs.
- 6 new AZs planned for 2027 in Stockholm and Frankfurt.
- 2 new GPU Zones: AMD in Sweden and NVIDIA B300 in Denmark.

results.title: Scaleway secures European “Trusted Cloud” services contract with Airbus  | Scaleway
results.author: Made with ❤️ by FWEB, VDESIGN, VI
highlights:
Scaleway and AMD are bringing Europe’s first commercial AMD AI supercomputer to Sweden, deploying AMD Instinct™ MI355X GPUs to give European companies greater choice in how they build and scale AI.

Paris, October 13, 2026 – On the occasion of ai-PULSE 2026, Scaleway today announces the deployment of a new AI supercomputer in Sweden featuring AMD Instinct™ MI355X GPUs.

Marking Scaleway’s first supercomputer deployment outside France, the new infrastructure will give startups, AI companies and enterprises across Europe access to AMD Instinct™ GPU capacity at scale.

...

The system will feature AMD Instinct™ MI355X GPUs and AMD ROCm™ open software, giving Scaleway customers access to high-performance AI compute and an open software ecosystem designed to support the development and deployment of AI workloads at scale. By adding AMD Instinct technology to its AI infrastructure portfolio, Scaleway is expanding the range of compute architectures available to customers and giving organizations greater choice as they develop and scale AI applications.

results.title: Scaleway accélère pour donner à l'Europe les moyens de ses ambitions dans l'IA | Scaleway
results.author: Made with ❤️ by FWEB, VDESIGN, VI
highlights:
Cette expansion s'accompagne d'investissements dans de nouvelles capacités de calcul, avec le développement de GPU Zones, des infrastructures dédiées à l'entraînement et à l'inférence des modèles d'intelligence artificielle à grande échelle.

Deux déploiements majeurs sont annoncés :

- À Stockholm, un nouveau cluster de GPU AMD Instinct™ MI355X, avec l'ambition de proposer une infrastructure de calcul parmi les premières de ce type chez un fournisseur cloud européen.
- À Copenhague, un nouveau cluster NVIDIA B300, comprenant plusieurs milliers de GPU et destiné à répondre aux besoins croissants de puissance de calcul des applications d'intelligence artificielle.
